text:
elaine.sales: Quick heads-up 0m: Prospect wants an expanded CAIQ/SIG entry for our BYOK options before legal signs the SOW. They asked specifically about key custody, rotation, and whether any key material ever leaves their environment.

Tom.engineer: TL;DR we support three integration patterns for POC and production: 1) Cloud-managed CMEK (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK/Azure Key Vault) where key material never leaves provider KMS; 2) Customer HSM via PKCS#11 or KMIP gateway (we connect to customer's HSM endpoint); 3) Temporary wrapped key export for limited POC testing (least preferred).

Devin.security: For SIG/CAIQ language I'd recommend explicit sentences. Suggested paragraph to paste: "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK). In cloud deployments customers may use provider KMS (CMEK) such that key material remains in the providers HSM. For on-prem or dedicated deployments customers may present an HSM endpoint (PKCS#11 or KMIP); Redwood authenticates to the appliance and does not persist unencrypted key material. Temporary wrapped key imports for short-lived POCs are supported by agreement and are rotated/expired after the engagement."

Tom.engineer: Add technical detail: we only accept roles/grants or asymmetric-wrapped keys. Example GCP snippet we can share for POC: ```bash
# grant service account access to CMEK key
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PRJ/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key --member=serviceAccount:redwood-poc-sa@prj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

Elaine.sales: They also asked about in-memory plaintext keys and whether we store DEKs on disk. Need bullet they can paste in vendor review doc.

Devin.security: Paste-friendly bullets: - DEKs are used in-memory only inside a hardened runtime process and are never written to disk in plaintext. - DEKs are zeroed from memory after use and key lifetimes are limited to the request scope. - Master/KEK material is controlled by the customer's KMS/HSM for BYOK modes; Redwood does not persist KEKs. - All key usages are logged; customers can provide audit logs for verification.

kms-ops-bot: Note: our internal runbook for key rollover (POC) is at https://internal.redwood/key-rollover (ask SRE for access).

Tom.engineer: For rotation cadence recommend we suggest: DEKs rotated every 30 days (or per-customer policy), KEKs rotated annually; on detection of compromise we trigger immediate key versioning and re-encryption workflows. We can include scripts to perform a zero-downtime key rollover during the POC.

Sara.custsuccess: I'll coordinate the security kickoff call. Can someone bundle the CAIQ answer, the short bullets, the rotation cadence, and a one-page POC checklist I can send to the customer security team?

Elaine.sales: I'll assemble. Proposed POC checklist (short): 1) Customer shares KMS key identifier or HSM connection details + attestation/cert. 2) Establish least-privilege grant for redwood-poc service principal. 3) Run encrypt/decrypt smoke test and capture KMS audit logs. 4) Execute sample inference with logging enabled. 5) Run provided key-rotation script and verify no downtime. 6) Deliver audit artifacts and HSM attestation to customer.

Devin.security: Also include the language about our SOC2 report and recommendation that customers request HSM attestation PDFs (FIPS certs) from their vendor as part of SIG evidence.

Elaine.sales: Great. I'll create a single ZIP with: CAIQ text, short bullets for the vendor review, rotation policy text, GCP/AWS command snippets, and the checklist. Will upload to the shared folder and post link here when ready. :white_check_mark:

Sara.custsuccess: Thanks 10x. I'll block 30 mins for Tue morning for the kickoff.

Tom.engineer: If you want more formal Q/A mapping to CAIQ questions I can map our bullets to specific CAIQ fields (KDE, KDI, KRM, etc.).

Devin.security: +1 to that. Also note: if the customer requires HSM attestation to be verified by a third party, we'll coordinate with them for evidence collection during the POC.

Elaine.sales: Perfect. Closing this thread for now; will post the bundle link when uploaded.
